sql:
/*
================================================================================
蜡笔小新繁体 - 商店购买与付费货币消耗
shop_buy 与同账号、同事件时间的 item_change 关联；排除黑名单及明确测试账号。
================================================================================
*/
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
ActiveUsers AS (
    SELECT
        v."$part_date" AS stat_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT v."#account_id") AS active_users
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist ub ON v."#user_id" = ub.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'login'
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
      AND ub.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
CurrencyChange AS (
    SELECT
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        v."#event_time" AS event_time,
        SUM(REDUCE(
            v.a_rst,
            CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
            (s, x) -> s + CASE
                WHEN CAST(x.id AS BIGINT) = 10009
                 AND CAST(x.before AS BIGINT) > CAST(x.after AS BIGINT)
                THEN ABS(CAST(x.diff AS BIGINT)) ELSE 0 END,
            s -> s
        )) AS red_diamond_consumed,
        SUM(REDUCE(
            v.a_rst,
            CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
            (s, x) -> s + CASE
                WHEN CAST(x.id AS BIGINT) = 10206
                 AND CAST(x.before AS BIGINT) > CAST(x.after AS BIGINT)
                THEN ABS(CAST(x.diff AS BIGINT)) ELSE 0 END,
            s -> s
        )) AS gem_consumed
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist ub ON v."#user_id" = ub.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'item_change'
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
      AND ub.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ShopLogs AS (
    SELECT
        v."$part_date" AS stat_date,
        CASE WHEN v.shop_item[1].shop_id > 10000 THEN '晶钻商城' ELSE '红钻商城' END AS shop_name,
        COALESCE(
            CAST(CAST(dp."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR),
            ARRAY_JOIN(TRANSFORM(v.a_rst, x -> CAST(CAST(x.id AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR)), '+')
        ) AS item_id,
        COALESCE(
            dp."product_id@product_name_tc",
            ARRAY_JOIN(TRANSFORM(v.a_rst, x -> CAST(x.name AS VARCHAR)), '+')
        ) AS item_name,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        v.shop_item AS shop_item,
        v.a_rst AS a_rst,
        COALESCE(c.red_diamond_consumed, 0) AS red_diamond_consumed,
        COALESCE(c.gem_consumed, 0) AS gem_consumed
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist ub ON v."#user_id" = ub.user_id
    LEFT JOIN CurrencyChange c
      ON v."#account_id" = c.account_id
     AND v."#event_time" = c.event_time
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_13_0_20639 dp
      ON CAST(v.shop_item[1].shop_id AS INTEGER) = CAST(dp."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'shop_buy'
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
      AND ub.user_id IS NULL
      AND v."#account_id" NOT IN ('65552', '65556')
)
SELECT
    s.stat_date AS "日期",
    s.shop_name AS "商店",
    s.item_id AS "道具ID",
    s.item_name AS "道具名称",
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN s.shop_name = '晶钻商城' THEN 1
        ELSE ABS(TRY_CAST(s.a_rst[1].diff AS BIGINT))
    END) AS "兑换总量",
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.account_id) AS "兑换人数",
    MAX(a.active_users) AS "活跃人数",
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.shop_item[1].item_id = 10206 THEN s.shop_item[1].num END) / 100.0 AS "消耗晶钻数",
    SUM(s.red_diamond_consumed) AS "消耗红钻数"
FROM ShopLogs s
LEFT JOIN ActiveUsers a ON s.stat_date = a.stat_date
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
HAVING
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.shop_item[1].item_id = 10206 THEN s.shop_item[1].num END), 0) > 0
    OR COALESCE(SUM(s.red_diamond_consumed), 0) > 0
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2, 5 DESC;
